ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: "Jordan nationally determines to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by a bulk of 14 % until 2030. This contribution of GHGs reduction will be unconditionally fulfilled at, maximally, 1.5 % by the Country's own means compared to a business as usual scenario level. However, Jordan, conditionally and subject to availability of international financial aid and support to means of implementation, commits to reduce its GHGs emissions by additional, at least, 12.5 % by 2030. The outcome targets above are accompanied by a diverse combination of numerous GHGs cutoriented actions in all involved sectors of emissions in addition to the adaptation actions in targeted sectors."
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: Maximally 1.5% (unconditional) to 14% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario

ndc_assessment.sectors: Energy (including transport), waste, industrial processes, agriculture and land-use, land-use change and forestry (LULUCF) and solvents

Jordan committed to reduce 5% compared to the BAU scenario unconditionally, and to reduce conditionally an additional 26% compared to BAU scenario if the resources and means of implementation are available.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-09-22. 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 38.5 MtCO₂e, DS-35 31 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 49.9 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Maximally 1.5% (unconditional) to 14% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.49°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.36°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
